name: HRT_PROFILE_TYP_SECTIONS
description: Profile Type Sections  table that holds the data for the various sections

columns.name: SECTION_ID
columns.description: Section ID

columns.name: DEFAULT_FLAG
columns.description: DEFAULT_FLAG

columns.name: DISPLAY_ORDER
columns.description: Display Order

columns.name: SECTION_LAYOUT
columns.description: Stores layout option for FUSE UI.

columns.name: BUSINESS_GROUP_ID
columns.description: Identifier of Enterprise, used for multi-tenancy partitioning. Foreign key to HR_ORGANIZATION_UNITS.

columns.name: PROFILE_TYPE_ID
columns.description: Profile Type ID

columns.name: CONTENT_TYPE_ID
columns.description: Content Type ID

columns.name: PARENT_SECTION_ID
columns.description: Parent Section ID

columns.name: CONTENT_TYPE_RELATION_ID
columns.description: Content Type Relation ID

columns.name: SECTION_ITEM_REQD_FLAG
columns.description: Section Item Required Flag

columns.name: APPROVAL_REQUIRED_FLAG
columns.description: Approval Required Flag

columns.name: QUALIFIER_SET_ID1
columns.description: Qualifier Set ID1

columns.name: QUALIFIER_SET_ID2
columns.description: Qualifier Set ID2

columns.name: SECTION_CONTEXT
columns.description: Section Context

columns.name: SECURITY_CONTEXT
columns.description: This column will have the same value as Section_Context for newly created sections. For sections that are upgraded from the old architecture, this column will have the value of Context_Name for the Content Type of the section.

columns.name: TEMPLATE_FLAG
columns.description: Template flag to indicate whether it is template or not

columns.name: DFF_CONTEXT_NAME
columns.description: DFF context name for each section

columns.name: ANALYTIC_PRIORITY
columns.description: Analytic priority to indicate the ordering of the data

columns.name: ANALYTIC_PRIORITY_SOURCE_CODE
columns.description: Analytic priority based on consumer

columns.name: ACTIVE_FLAG
columns.description: Active flag to indicate whether the section is active ('Y') or inactive (null/ 'N')

columns.name: MODULE_ID
columns.description: Seed Data Framework: indicates the module that owns the row. A module is an entry in Application Taxonomy such as a Logical Business Area. When the MODULE_ID column exists and the owner of the row is not specified, then the Seed Data Framework will not extract the row as seed data.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: TEMPLATE_BASED_SECTION_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to indicate whether section is based on template or not

columns.name: LINKEDIN_ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Linkedin enable flag is use to indicate whether the section is supporting linkedin data ('Y') or not (null/ 'N')

columns.name: SKILL_RECOMMEND_ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to indicate whether Skills content section supports system-generated recommendations ('Y') or not (null/ 'N')

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.
